description: Checks MTA-STS for a mail domain: the _mta-sts TXT record (v=STSv1 and id) and the HTTPS policy file (mode enforce, testing or none, the MX patterns and max_age). Reports whether the record and the policy are both present and whether the policy's version is valid. Does not test the mail servers themselves. Choose this tool for: Checks MTA-STS for a mail domain: the _mta-sts TXT record. Close alternatives on this server: security_dnssec_validator (DNSSEC check for a domain: whether a DS record exists); security_barracuda_reputation (Checks an IPv4 mail-sending address against the Barracuda). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
